criteria.reason: The client now applies a single multiplier of 2 when either flag is enabled, including when both are enabled.
The OR-based multiplier doubles the tonnage when either individual flag is enabled.
The client formula is fixed, but the attempt also changes server-side tonnage calculations despite tonnage being display-only.
No database columns or migrations were added.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
New tests cover the expected value, but the client test uses a hard-coded expression rather than exercising the client calculation.
